winner.hypothesis: The ferroptosis-sensitive ILC molecular subtype (FRGS-high from PMID 41815159) is characterized by elevated expression of SLC7A11 (xCT, the cystine transporter), GPX4, and ACSL4. Methylation of the SLC7A11 promoter — an ILC-subtype-specific epigenetic mark — is detectable in cell-free DNA and differentiates FRGS-high from FRGS-low ILC without tissue biopsy. FRGS-high ILC patients have elevated susceptibility to RSL3 (GPX4 inhibitor) and erastin class compounds, representing a druggable vulnerability specific to this subtype.
winner.mechanism: SLC7A11 promoter methylation is an established epigenetic silencing mark in ferroptosis resistance; ILC-subtype-specific methylation patterns propagate to cfDNA through ctDNA shedding
winner.testable_experiment: Query TCGA WGBS data for SLC7A11/GPX4 promoter methylation differential between ILC ferroptosis subtypes; then check if signal appears in any cfDNA-WGBS public dataset
winner.addresses_gap: Gaps 1 & 4 — FRGS gene specificity and cross-cohort validation

runner_up.hypothesis: CDH1 loss-of-function mutations, which define ILC and are detectable in ctDNA via Guardant360 (PMID 36332363), are present at detectably higher variant allele frequencies in early-stage ILC pre-surgical plasma compared to matched IDC controls — making CDH1 the anchor marker for a non-personalized, biopsy-independent ILC liquid biopsy panel applicable at screening.
runner_up.mechanism: CDH1 somatic LOF is near-universal in ILC (~85% of cases) and creates a high-prior-probability target for ctDNA detection without requiring tumor-informed personalization
runner_up.testable_experiment: Retrospective analysis of Guardant360 early-stage ILC samples vs age/stage-matched IDC; CDH1 VAF distribution comparison
